text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The joint dorm Christmas party—a modest annual gathering.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: We decorate the common area, prepare sweets, and plan recreations. Our duty is to bring everyone a peaceful and pleasant time of rest...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Now then, we will begin the Christmas Party Planning Meeting! The meeting place will be the Miho Dorm lobby, so gather here every night!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: First, please check the documents in front of you! This is the plan drafted based on previous years’ Christmas parties.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Let’s see~? Pour juice, make a toast. Everyone eats sweets and chats, socializes. And do board game recreations...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: C’mon now that’s a plain rice ball! At least put some popping candy in it! Fire a bazooka!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wah! Fire is strictly prohibited here! If you fool around too much, I will escort you straight to the staff room!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: It is our responsibility to provide a peaceful and restful Christmas party for all participants. Violating regulations is forbidden!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph. How utterly tasteless.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: In any case, for now let us consider things along the content drafted here. We will need role assignments, won’t we... The first toast greeting—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall do it. If the king hosts it, that is only fitting.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ! Are you certain we may entrust you with it? Even arranging drinks...? I see. Then please do.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: What shall we do about sweets? There’s the budget to consider... we’ll need to be a bit creative. Maybe handmade...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: Heh... right. Leave that part to me. I’ll try making a few things.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Next is recreation. Fine, the embodiment of entertainment, Golshi-chan, will think this one through.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Then, may we leave the venue decorations to you, Meno? I will take care of the rest of the miscellaneous duties.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (They all seem more cooperative than expected... I didn’t think the meeting would go this smoothly...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (I must stay vigilant, but... we’re running this with five people. I want to work together properly to make this a good Christmas party.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you for your cooperation. Your willingness to take initiative is a great help.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Please be sure not to neglect your duty to report progress. Do your utmost on your assigned tasks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (System Monologue)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Alright. I’m glad we have plenty of origami and tissue flowers! I must thank the student council for their help—!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Fireworks!? At this distance... that’s inside campus! Only one person would do something this outrageous—!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What are you doing there! Orfe-san!!!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A test shot. Magnificent, is it not.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh!? What nonsense are you saying! Doing something like this without permission— the fire laws, the procedures, the costs, aaah...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It was done by a certified contractor; there is no fire hazard. If I am opening the event, it must be grand and lively.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What I entrusted to you was the toast speech!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (Because of that, even I was summoned to the guidance room yesterday... I specifically asked them to cooperate properly—)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Sniff sniff... this is... the smell of wrongdoing... no, something physically smells!? Spices, and sweetness...!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Is it here!? I’m going in—!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —!! ......!? What... what are you doing...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: Oh, making test batches of sweets for the Christmas party. The first batch just finished baking. Want to taste one?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah... right, you were in charge of sweets... My apologies for suddenly suspecting you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Oh, these are mini cream puffs. They look very delicious! Then, with your permission—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! You pulled the jackpot on your first try, Meno!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: They’re “Russian Roulette Cream Puffs.” The jackpot has ultra-hot habanero paste. Burns, doesn’t it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Mixing hazardous substances is practically a crime!! These are confiscated!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Honestly, those people! They aren’t planning to ruin the Christmas party... are they! —Hmm? That is...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heave ho, heave ho! A~la heave ho!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Golshi-san? What are you doing— what are you DOING!? Are you digging!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn’t it obvious? I’m building the stage for the Pitfall Surprise Reaction Championship.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What kind of dangerously unsafe championship is that!! Digging holes on school grounds without permission is a violation—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Stop right there! You’re detained—!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The shovel is confiscated, and you will properly fill in the hole you dug!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Tch~ I was so close to finishing the stage. Have your tracking skills gone up? You got a jet engine installed?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It seems you lost control a little, Golshi-san. It’s certainly an eccentric recreation idea...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: Kuku, I’d like to try it though. A stage where you risk falling into a pit and bombing the reaction? Sounds fun.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Nakayama-san, you too! And Orfe-san as well!! Rule violations, hazardous ingredients, dangerous games...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Are you planning to ruin the Christmas party!? Please prepare properly, following the original plan!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: How boring. Your attitude is far too safe.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Your “fun” isn’t the standard!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ahh really... the only one doing things properly is Journey-senpai... at this rate...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: I get what you’re saying, Meno. But aren’t you being a bit one-sided? We’re also members of the “operations team.” We have our own ideas.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: If our opinions clash this hard, there’s no helping it. In that case... let’s settle it with this.
